report.name: feature_guard_sdio
report.purpose: Small utility predicate that tests a feature bitmask against a global SDIO feature word to determine whether a given SDIO capability is currently enabled in firmware. It is a thin guard used by the clock-calculation path (250_clock_calc.synth.c) to gate clock configuration on per-build/per-chip SDIO feature availability. Belongs to the firmware utility / build-feature gating subsystem.

parameters.name: feature_mask
parameters.purpose: Bitmask of the SDIO feature bit(s) to test against the global feature word.

return_value.meaning: true if every bit set in feature_mask is also set in the SDIO feature word; false otherwise.

side_effects: Reads a global SDIO feature word (no MMIO accesses; pure RAM load — no hardware side effects could be observed because the function body at 0x122ecd0 lies past the loaded image and disassembles to 0xFFFFFFFF padding in fmacfw_8800d80_u02_bin, fmacfw_8800d80_h_u02_bin, fmacfwbt_8800d80_u02_bin, and lmacfw_rf_8800d80_u02_bin).
report.summary: SDIO feature-bit guard predicate: returns whether requested feature bits are present in the global SDIO feature word.
